METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. When learning Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Metalwork 1.2 Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Meta.

4. When learning Measuring and marking out tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and marking out tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and marking out tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and marking out tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand tools and bench tools 2.2 Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and n.

7. When learning Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and Non- ferrous metals.

8. When learning Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 .

9. When learning Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro.

10. When learning Hand tools and bench tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hand tools and bench tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand tools and bench tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand tools and bench tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand tools and bench tools.

11. When learning Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety at workshop 2.0 Tools and materials in Metalwork 2.1 Hand tools and bench.

12. When learning Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and marking out tools 2.3 Ferrous and non-ferrous metals 2.4 Project 3.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project 3.0 Related drawing in Metalwork 3.1 Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictoria and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Scales and conventions 3.2 Pictorial drawing 4.0 Metal joining and finishing pro and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Scales and conventions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pictorial drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
